notes.text: WORKFLOW: circatidal rhythm (12.4 h). Rhythm analysis is not circadian-only. A coastal invertebrate timed to the tides runs at the lunar semi-diurnal period, 12.42 h, and because successive tides are unequal there is a weaker component near 24.8 h as well. The thing to notice is the SEARCH WINDOW. AnCiR's periodogram defaults to 20-28 h, which is right for circadian work and wrong here: it would find the 24.8 h component, report it confidently, and miss the dominant tidal peak entirely. Widening the window to 6-30 h shows both. Whenever you analyse a system you have not analysed before, set the window from the biology, not from the default.
